resources.string: Paste the pairing URI generated by your computer.
Pairing complete. This device is securely paired.
Pairing succeeded, but the device credential could not be saved securely.
Unable to load the saved pairing: %1$s
This saved pairing predates persistent connections. Pair again once to save the PC endpoint.
The PC no longer recognizes this pairing. Pair again to reconnect.
Connection service stopped. Tap Start connection after pairing.
No saved pairing. Pair with your computer before starting.
Saved pairing or PC endpoint is missing, invalid, or unreadable. Pair again before starting.
Could not start the connection service. Return to the app and try again.
Connection service unavailable. Reopen the app to start manually.

Pairing does not start the connection. Start it manually to stay connected while the app is backgrounded or the phone is locked. Stop closes the connection and cancels reconnect attempts. Stop the connection before pairing again.

Allow notifications for agent events and the ongoing PC connection status with its Stop action. The service can run without notification permission; on Android 13+, denial hides notifications from the drawer (the service is still listed in Active apps). Agent-event content requests public lock-screen visibility, but Android and your privacy settings may conceal it. Permission or an accepted request does not prove Android displayed a notification.
Notification permission is allowed. Channel and privacy settings still control visibility.
Notifications are not allowed or are disabled. Allow them or change Notification settings. You can still Start and Stop here.
